subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Importance of drinking clean water and eating fresh food; sorts foods into two groups and explains

show.line: Our bodies need clean water every day. Fresh food keeps us well!

rounds.prompt: Which water is safe to drink?
Fresh food, or old food? Sort them.
You are thirsty after playing. What is the best drink?

rounds.story: Zanele finds bread with green spots on it. Should she eat it?
rounds.praise: No! Green spots mean the bread is old.

rounds.prompt: We wash fruit before we eat it. Tap the child washing fruit.

hints: Fresh food looks bright and smells good.
Water is the best drink for our bodies.

beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I will drink water from the puddle!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Puddle water is dirty. Drink clean water.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Only clean water. Never puddle water!

parent_line: Knows to drink clean water and choose fresh food.
